changes.text: Module dependency graph: added d3-zoom pan/wheel-zoom so crowded scans (17+ modules) can be navigated. Larger arrow markers (12x12, userSpaceOnUse) make direction visible at any link weight. Marker IDs now per-render so they don't collide across snapshot navigations.

Graph labels strip the longest shared dotted prefix client-side (e.g. 'app.routers.foo' → 'routers.foo' when every module starts with 'app.'), and the package-color rules now match dotted paths (.routers., .database, .scanner, .analyzer).

build_orm_mermaid now finds the database module by leaf-name suffix instead of exact match, so scans without sub_path (modules named 'app.database') get a real class diagram instead of 'NoDatabaseModule'. Requires a re-scan.

build_layers_mermaid: detects main / database / routers.* by leaf-name suffix and strips the shared common prefix from non-ambiguous labels. Drops main/database/routers subgraphs when the underlying modules aren't present. Requires a re-scan.

Per-commit snapshot: architectural-layers and ORM class diagrams rendered as plain text because mermaid v10 auto-runs on window-load with startOnLoad:true, marking the still-empty pre.mermaid blocks as data-processed before app.js could fill them. Switched to mermaid.render() into div.mermaid-host containers, which bypasses the auto-init race entirely.

Per-commit snapshot: restored the coupling-matrix heat-map next to the metrics table (was in the original analyze.py one-shot HTML but missed in the live-app refactor). Cell intensity = number of names module A imports from module B.

build_layers_mermaid: services subgraph now dynamically discovered from the analyzed modules instead of hardcoded to scheduler/scanner/analyzer — so layered diagrams look right for any scanned repo, not just code-archaeology itself. Requires a re-scan to take effect on existing commits.

Timeline charts were empty because drawCharts() set parsing:false + normalized:true while still passing raw numeric arrays against category labels — Chart.js couldn't project the points onto the x-axis. Removed both flags (no perf benefit at our scale) and added spanGaps so commits with null avg_lcom4 render as gaps.
scanner: redact the entire git error message (not just stderr) — the token-bearing URL appears in the echoed command line too, and was leaking into the UI and persisted ScanJob.error rows
scanner: redaction now also regex-strips any user:token@ basic-auth prefix from https URLs, so stale/rotated tokens in old errors can't leak either
Scanner injects $GITHUB_TOKEN into https://github.com/... clone/fetch URLs so private repos can be scanned without per-repo credentials
Deploy workflow writes GITHUB_TOKEN into .env from the GH_PRIVATE_REPO_TOKEN repo secret so private-repo access survives reboots and redeploys
Caddyfile: serve HTTP on :80 when DOMAIN is unset so IP/LAN access works; HSTS now only sent over HTTPS
Initial scaffold — register repos, scan every commit, browse timeline + per-commit architecture snapshots
Python AST analyzer with LOC, fan-in/out, instability, LCOM4 per module
Generic LOC fallback for non-Python files (TODO: deeper analysis via tree-sitter)
Hot-spots view — modules with worst-trending metrics over a window
Configurable commit filter (all / since / last_n / range / sha_list); default scans every commit
